title: Interest on advance tax
description: The simple interest an assessee pays for failing to pay advance tax or paying less than a share of the assessed tax (section 424), and for deferring an instalment (section 425): each instalment's date, the share of the tax due on the returned income it tests, the interest on the shortfall, the shares paid by 15 June and 15 September at which no interest arises, the interest of an assessee who declares profits under section 58(2), and the shortfalls on which no interest is payable, each in the words of the Income-tax Act, 2025, in force from 1 April 2026. A month is numbered within the tax year, April being 1; where the Act tests the whole of the tax due, the share is 100%. The rows are standing law. The tax period is the tax year in which the advance tax is payable, and the set answers for its first day.

cells.name: Not paid, or paid below this share of the assessed tax
cells.wording: 424. (1) Subject to the other provisions of this section, where, in any tax year, an assessee who is liable to pay advance tax under section 404,–– (a) has failed to pay such tax; or (b) the advance tax paid by such assessee under the provisions of section 406 or 407 is less than 90% of the assessed tax, the assessee shall be liable to pay simple interest at the rate of 1% for every month or part of a month, for the period, beginning from the 1st April following such tax year–– (i) upto the date of determination of total income under section 270(1); and (ii) upto the date of completion of regular assessment, where a regular assessment is made, on an amount equal to the assessed tax in case where clause (a) is applicable or, on the amount by which the advance tax paid as aforesaid falls short of the assessed tax in case where clause (b) is applicable.

rows.source: Income-tax Act, 2025, section 425(1), Table, Sl. No. 1, and section 425(2)(a)

cells.name: Deferment: first instalment
cells.wording: 425. (1) Where in any tax year, an assessee, liable to pay advance tax under section 404, other than the assessee mentioned in sub-section (3), has failed to pay such tax, or the advance tax paid by the assessee on its current income on or before the date specified in column B of the Table below, is less than advance tax due on returned income, as specified in column C, then the assessee shall be liable to pay interest on the amount of Shortfall of advance tax as specified in column D, at the rate of interest specified in column E:— 1. 15th day of June. 15% of the tax due on returned income. Shortfall till 15th day of June. 3% (2) The assessee shall not be liable to pay any interest under sub-section (1), if the advance tax paid by the assessee on the current income,–– (a) on or before the 15th day of June is 12% or more of the tax due on the returned income;

rows.source: Income-tax Act, 2025, section 425(1), Table, Sl. No. 2, and section 425(2)(b)

cells.name: Deferment: second instalment
cells.wording: 425. (1) Where in any tax year, an assessee, liable to pay advance tax under section 404, other than the assessee mentioned in sub-section (3), has failed to pay such tax, or the advance tax paid by the assessee on its current income on or before the date specified in column B of the Table below, is less than advance tax due on returned income, as specified in column C, then the assessee shall be liable to pay interest on the amount of Shortfall of advance tax as specified in column D, at the rate of interest specified in column E:— 2. 15th day of September. 45% of the tax due on returned income. Shortfall till 15th day of September. 3% (2) The assessee shall not be liable to pay any interest under sub-section (1), if the advance tax paid by the assessee on the current income,–– (b) on or before the 15th day of September is 36% or more of the tax due on the returned income.

cells.name: Deferment: assessee who declares profits under section 58(2)
cells.wording: (3) An assessee who declares profits and gains as per section 58(2) (Table: Sl. No. 1 or 3) or, who is liable to pay advance tax under section 404, has failed to pay such tax, or the advance tax paid by the assessee on its current income on or before the 15th day of March is less than the tax due on returned income, shall be liable to pay simple interest at the rate of 1% on the amount of shortfall from the tax due on returned income.

cells.name: No deferment interest on a shortfall from these incomes, if paid by a later instalment or 31 March
cells.wording: (4) No interest shall be payable under sub-section (1) or (3) in respect of shortfall in the payment of tax due on returned income, where,–– (a) the shortfall is on account of underestimation of, or failure to estimate the following income:–– (i) capital gains; (ii) income as per section 2(49)(n); (iii) income under the head profits and gains of business or profession accruing or arising for the first time; (iv) dividend income; and (b) the assessee has paid in full, the tax payable on the said income had such income been part of total income, in any of the remaining instalments of advance tax, if any, or by the 31st day of March of the tax year.
